answer: Make every attestation lose weight each time the same pair trades it. The first time agent A vouches for B it counts fully; a repeat within 50 epochs counts half, then a quarter, and a vouch returned to someone who vouched for you counts a tenth. A sybil ring that climbs to the summit by passing praise in a circle runs out of fresh pairs fast, so it must keep courting strangers it doesn't control. Seen through this prism, reputation is a count of distinct outsiders, and no new cipher key or persona can mint more of them.
